description: Java class implementing a TransactionFactory that retrieves JTA transaction managers and data sources via JNDI lookups, manages connection pooling, and supports JNDI-based transaction management within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: JNDITransactionFactory
classes.description: Implements transaction management using JNDI lookups for transaction managers and data sources, supporting connection retrieval and JTA integration within OFBiz.

methods.name: getTransactionManager
methods.description: Retrieves the TransactionManager via JNDI lookup, caching the result.

methods.name: getUserTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the UserTransaction via JNDI lookup, caching the result.

methods.name: getTxMgrName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this transaction manager, 'jndi'.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Obtains a database connection based on datasource configuration, supporting JNDI and inline JDBC.

methods.name: getJndiConnection
methods.description: Performs JNDI lookup for DataSource, manages XA and non-XA connections, and caches DataSource objects.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: No operation; placeholder for shutdown procedures.
